# What PlanetScale tokens the library redacts, and what it leaves alone.
#
# Every token here is built from the ordered run 0123456789abcdef, which no real
# credential is: a body is forty-three base64url characters, so the run twice
# over and eleven more is one, and the three prefixes bring a token to
# fifty-four, fifty-six and sixty-four. Where a case turns on the wider
# alphabet, the uppercase letters, the hyphen or the underscore are written
# among the run and the body stays forty-three characters.

patterns: planetscale-token

# The three prefixes PlanetScale writes a token with, one to a kind: pscale_tkn_
# for the service token an organization is given, pscale_oauth_ for the access
# token an application receives from the OAuth flow, pscale_oauth_refresh_ for
# the refresh token handed out beside it. They are one pattern because a caller
# with reason to redact any of them has the same reason for the rest, and the
# cases below are the three of them in the places a token is written.

case:     a service token in an environment assignment
in:       PLANETSCALE_SERVICE_TOKEN=pscale_tkn_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789a
out:      PLANETSCALE_SERVICE_TOKEN=«planetscale-token»

case:     a token in the header a request carries it in
in:       Authorization: Bearer pscale_tkn_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789a
out:      Authorization: Bearer «planetscale-token»

case:     an access token and the refresh token the oauth flow returns beside it
in:       {"access_token":"pscale_oauth_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789a","token_type":"Bearer","refresh_token":"pscale_oauth_refresh_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789a"}
out:      {"access_token":"«planetscale-token»","token_type":"Bearer","refresh_token":"«planetscale-token»"}

case:     a token in the command line a request is made from
in:       curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer pscale_tkn_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789a' https://api.planetscale.com/v1/organizations
out:      curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer «planetscale-token»' https://api.planetscale.com/v1/organizations

# The identifier a service token is kept under is written beside the token
# wherever the CLI reads one, and is no credential: twelve characters carrying
# none of the three prefixes.

case:     a service token beside the identifier it is kept under
in:       PLANETSCALE_SERVICE_TOKEN_ID=ihk9lqudel8z PLANETSCALE_SERVICE_TOKEN=pscale_tkn_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789a
out:      PLANETSCALE_SERVICE_TOKEN_ID=ihk9lqudel8z PLANETSCALE_SERVICE_TOKEN=«planetscale-token»

# The alphabet the forty-three characters are written in: base64url, which is
# what thirty-two bytes are encoded in to come to that many. So the letters of
# both cases, the digits, the hyphen and the underscore all stand in a body. The
# prefix is read in one case alone. What the alphabet leaves out is what two of
# the three rulesets reading this format admit — the equals sign that is
# base64's padding, and the dot, which belongs to no encoding — so a run
# carrying either is no token.

case:     a body written with the uppercase letters
in:       pscale_tkn_0123456789abcdefABCDEF0123456789abcdefABCDE
out:      «planetscale-token»

case:     a body carrying a hyphen and an underscore
in:       pscale_tkn_0123456789abcdef-0123456789abcdef_012345678
out:      «planetscale-token»

case:     an uppercase prefix
in:       PSCALE_TKN_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789a
out:      PSCALE_TKN_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789a

case:     a body carrying the padding character
in:       pscale_tkn_0123456789abcdef=123456789abcdef0123456789a
out:      pscale_tkn_0123456789abcdef=123456789abcdef0123456789a

case:     a body carrying a dot
in:       pscale_tkn_0123456789abcdef.123456789abcdef0123456789a
out:      pscale_tkn_0123456789abcdef.123456789abcdef0123456789a

# The lengths either side of forty-three. That count is what the two tokens
# PlanetScale's API reference prints are written to and what trufflehog reads
# behind the service token's prefix, and it is used as a count rather than a
# floor: forty-two characters are not a token, and forty-four are a token and
# one character that belongs to no credential. The second of those is the price
# of having no boundary behind the match — a boundary there would drop this
# token rather than trim it, and a real token written against a character of the
# same alphabet would come through whole.

case:     a body of forty-three characters is a token
in:       pscale_tkn_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789a
out:      «planetscale-token»

case:     a body of forty-two characters is not
in:       pscale_tkn_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789
out:      pscale_tkn_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789

case:     a base64url run longer than a token is a token and what follows it
in:       pscale_tkn_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789a0
out:      «planetscale-token»0

# What a token may be written against. The prefix is the whole of the anchor and
# there is no boundary on either side of it, so a token keeps its span whatever
# word character it abuts.

case:     a token after an underscore
in:       PLANETSCALE_SERVICE_TOKEN_pscale_tkn_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789a
out:      PLANETSCALE_SERVICE_TOKEN_«planetscale-token»

case:     a token after a letter
in:       xpscale_tkn_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789a
out:      x«planetscale-token»

case:     a token before a hyphenated word
in:       pscale_tkn_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789a-suffix
out:      «planetscale-token»-suffix

case:     a token at the end of a sentence
in:       the token is pscale_tkn_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789a.
out:      the token is «planetscale-token».

# The refresh token is written behind the access token's own prefix, and
# everything between them — refresh_ — is written in the body's alphabet. So a
# whole refresh token is also pscale_oauth_ with forty-three characters behind
# it, and both readings are true of the same text. A kind is tried before any
# kind that is an opening of it, so a refresh token is one span of sixty-four
# characters rather than that span and the fifty-six character one inside it;
# where the longer reading has too little behind it the shorter is taken, and a
# refresh prefix with thirty-five characters behind it is an access token's
# shape exactly.

case:     a refresh token
in:       pscale_oauth_refresh_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789a
out:      «planetscale-token»

case:     a refresh prefix with an access token's body behind it
in:       pscale_oauth_refresh_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012
out:      «planetscale-token»

case:     a refresh prefix with a body too short for either reading
in:       pscale_oauth_refresh_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01
out:      pscale_oauth_refresh_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01

# Two tokens written together. Every character of a prefix is written in the
# body's alphabet, so a prefix can stand anywhere inside a body and a token
# written inside another is located as well as the one around it. The two spans
# overlap there and are redacted as one. Written without that overlap the two
# are separate values and both go.

case:     two tokens with nothing between them
in:       pscale_tkn_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789apscale_oauth_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789a
out:      «planetscale-token»«planetscale-token»

case:     a prefix written where a body would stand
in:       pscale_tkn_pscale_tkn_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789a
out:      «planetscale-token»

# What this pattern redacts that nobody issued, and the other credentials
# PlanetScale writes with the same opening. A body is base64url, which is what a
# JWT segment, a web push key and a routable payload are written in, so the
# prefix and forty-three characters of an encoded blob is a token with nothing
# left over to tell the two apart. That is the answer rather than a fault in it,
# because sparing it would spare a real token. What the kind turns away is the
# database password, which PlanetScale calls a password and never a token, and
# the name its CLI gives a Postgres role.

case:     an encoded blob behind the prefix
in:       pscale_tkn_eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ90123456789abcdef0123456
out:      «planetscale-token»

case:     a database password
in:       pscale_pw_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789a
out:      pscale_pw_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789a

case:     a database password in the connection string it is written into
in:       mysql://0123456789abcd:pscale_pw_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789a@aws.connect.psdb.cloud/main
out:      mysql://0123456789abcd:pscale_pw_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789a@aws.connect.psdb.cloud/main

case:     the opening a postgres role is named by
in:       pscale_api_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789a
out:      pscale_api_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789a

# And what else this pattern leaves alone. The first three are the prefix, read
# with the kind PlanetScale writes and the underscores around it; then a body a
# space has broken, and three inputs carrying no prefix at all.

case:     a hyphen where the prefix carries its underscores
in:       pscale-tkn-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789a
out:      pscale-tkn-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789a

case:     the kind without the underscore that closes it
in:       pscale_tkn0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789ab
out:      pscale_tkn0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789ab

case:     the opening alone
in:       pscale_
out:      pscale_

case:     a body broken by a space
in:       pscale_tkn_0123456789abcdef 123456789abcdef0123456789a
out:      pscale_tkn_0123456789abcdef 123456789abcdef0123456789a

case:     a run of the right length opening with no prefix
in:       xxxxxx_tkn_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789a
out:      xxxxxx_tkn_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789a

case:     prose
in:       there is no credential in this sentence
out:      there is no credential in this sentence

case:     a log line naming the api a token authenticates against
in:       time=2026-08-17T00:00:00Z level=info msg="calling api" url=https://api.planetscale.com/v1/organizations
out:      time=2026-08-17T00:00:00Z level=info msg="calling api" url=https://api.planetscale.com/v1/organizations
